note: Placeholder numbers. Tuned with the bot from M1 onward. happy_amount and happy_uses_per_turn are what a happy villager adds (specs/bridge.md section 4). cost_amount is what the perk costs (Chum: +1 enemy attack), and die is the dice row a die_faces perk puts in place of die 0 or an add_die perk adds last (specs/bridge.md section 3). Villagers give the first four, shops the rest. gain, cost and happy_gain are the Kit tab's lines (Mara: every perk shows its cost as well as its gain; a villager's perk costs nothing, and happy_gain is what a happy villager adds).

items.name: Nudge
items.text: Once per turn, raise one die by 1.
items.gain: Raise one die by 1, once a turn

items.name: Foresight
items.text: See one extra room ahead on the delve map.
items.gain: See one more row of rooms ahead
items.happy_gain: One more row, so two in all

items.name: Weighted die
items.text: Your first die rolls 2, 3, 3, 4, 4 or 5. Steadier, but never a 6.
items.gain: Your first die never rolls a 1

items.name: Slow pour
items.text: In fights, reroll without spending a die, twice per fight. It replaces the usual reroll.
items.gain: In fights, reroll without spending a die
items.cost: Only twice a fight, and no usual reroll

items.name: Chum
items.text: Treasure rooms pay 1 more of each resource they pay, but every enemy hits 1 harder.
items.gain: +1 of each resource from treasure rooms

items.name: Spare die
items.text: Take a fifth die down, a d4. It sits out of Koban's vault.
items.cost: Small faces, and it sits out of Koban's vault
